title: One (Remastered)
lyrics:
[01:44.39]I can't remember anything
[01:47.95]Can't tell if this is true or dream
[01:51.48]Deep down inside, I feel to scream
[01:54.81]This terrible silence stops with me
[01:57.98]Now that the war is through with me
[02:01.61]I'm waking up, I cannot see
[02:05.23]That there's not much left of me
[02:08.72]Nothing is real but pain now
[02:11.20]Hold my breath as I wish for death
[02:16.03]Oh please, God, wake me
[02:32.92]Back in the womb, it's much too real
[02:36.46]In pumps life that I must feel
[02:39.75]But can't look forward to reveal
[02:43.60]Look to the time when I'll live
[02:46.61]Fed through the tube that sticks in me
[02:50.13]Just like a wartime novelty
[02:53.72]Tied to machines that make me be
[02:57.32]Cut this life off from me
[02:59.76]Hold my breath as I wish for death
[03:04.57]Oh please, God, wake me
[03:34.88]Now the world is gone, I'm just one
[03:39.70]Oh God, help me
[03:41.85]Hold my breath as I wish for death
[03:46.51]Oh please, God, help me
[04:52.75]Darkness
[04:53.70]Imprisoning me
[04:55.01]All that I see
[04:56.10]Absolute horror
[04:57.25]I cannot live
[04:58.25]I cannot die
[04:59.30]Trapped in myself
[05:00.39]Body, my holding cell
[05:10.08]Landmine
[05:10.92]Has taken my sight
[05:12.25]Taken my speech
[05:13.40]Taken my hearing
[05:14.52]Taken my arms
[05:15.56]Taken my legs
[05:16.61]Taken my soul
[05:17.65]Left me with life in Hell
